description: Map a design component to a code component, so get_design_context names the code component for every instance of it. Pass an instance, component or component set id; a component in a set maps the whole set.

fileKey.description: The key of the Figma file. Accepted for compatibility; the file open in Figma Desktop is always used.

nodeId.description: The ID of the node, eg. "123:456" or "123-456" (instance ids like "I1:2;3:4" work too). Omit it to use the current selection in Figma.

source.description: Path of the code component in the project.

name: add_code_connect_map
title: Add Code Connect Mapping
